reason: Pay-when-happy is decent, but £655 plus £43 a month is still real money for me when I can knock up a Wix or Squarespace page myself for a tenner a month, or get a mate to do it. Good enough is good enough for my lot.
objection: It's never just £655 - there's £43 every month after, and SEO at £325 a month is a joke for a business my size. Ongoing costs add up and I'm paying a bloke in Kuwait I've never met with no UK reviews.
would_change_my_mind: A proper all-in price under about £400 with hosting included for the first year, so there's no monthly bill straight away.
